request.style: English, cinematic orchestral anthem, soaring female soprano lead with full mixed choir, strings, French horns, timpani, harp, piano, rising from quiet to triumphant, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the road is hard and the night is long
When the bread runs out and the strength is gone
When the sword is drawn and the danger near
There is one question that rises over fear

[Pre-Chorus]
Who will separate us from the love of Christ?

[Chorus]
I am convinced that neither death nor life
Neither angels nor rulers
Neither the present nor the future, nor any powers
Neither height nor depth
Nor anything else in all creation
Will be able to separate us from the love of God
That is in Christ Jesus our Lord

[Verse]
Hardship or distress or persecution
Famine or nakedness or danger or the sword
For your sake we are being put to death all day long
We are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered

[Pre-Chorus]
Who will separate us from the love of Christ?

[Chorus]
I am convinced that neither death nor life
Neither angels nor rulers
Neither the present nor the future, nor any powers
Neither height nor depth
Nor anything else in all creation
Will be able to separate us from the love of God
That is in Christ Jesus our Lord

[Bridge]
No, in all these things
We are more than conquerors
Through him who loved us

[Outro]
Nothing can separate us
From the love of God
That is in Christ Jesus our Lord
